opening.opening_summary: A Zerg opening that prioritizes economy and expansion while maintaining a ground-oriented army. Early game focuses on Zerglings and Queens, with a transition to heavier ground compositions and technology as the game progresses.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a strong economy and expansion lead while building a versatile ground army. Maintain flexibility to adapt to Protoss tech choices, whether they go ground, air, or tech-heavy.
